_readme: Curated per-game emulation fixes imported into ArcadeGameProfile via `arcade-gameconfig-import`. Reviewed + source-cited; NOT auto-pulled (no clean machine-readable per-game DB exists — RetroArch overrides are user-authored, libretro-database is metadata, flycast's gamedb is compiled-in). SAFETY: forcedFps is only correct for games that DOUBLE-SPEED in our stack (advance one engine step per retro_run, like Sonic Adventure); a self-limiting 30fps game would be HALVED. So 'confidence' gates apply: only 'verified' (observed to double-speed here) applies by default; 'high' (confirmed 30fps native online, but not yet stack-verified) needs --min-confidence high AND a play-test. Core-option fixes (coreOptions) don't carry this risk. See docs/arcade-per-game-config.md.

fixes.title: Sonic Adventure
fixes.notes: 30fps-locked engine, physics tied to the frame limit; flycast advertises the 59.94Hz DC display refresh so it ran at 2x. Verified in our stack (PACE instrumentation + logged [game-override]).

fixes.title: Sonic Adventure 2
fixes.notes: Same engine family as Sonic Adventure (30fps-locked, physics tied to frame rate).

fixes.title: Skies of Arcadia
fixes.notes: Native 30fps; community reports it 'runs at double speed' in emulation and ships a 60Hz desync-fix patch — strong double-speed candidate, but not yet play-tested in our stack.

fixes.title: Shenmue
fixes.notes: Confirmed native 30fps on Dreamcast (does not run at 60fps). Candidate for the same double-speed class; verify with a play-test before relying.

fixes.title: Grandia II
fixes.notes: Confirmed 30fps throughout on Dreamcast (the later PC port added a 60fps combat patch). Verify double-speed before relying.
